id: The water cycle G5 P2

view.ask: Put the four main stages of the water cycle in order, starting with the sun warming the water on Earth.
correct_order: Evaporation: The sun warms water in lakes and oceans, turning it into invisible water vapor that rises into the sky.
Condensation: As water vapor rises and cools, it gathers into tiny liquid drops to form clouds.
Precipitation: The water droplets in clouds become too heavy to stay in the air and fall to Earth as rain, snow, or sleet.
Collection: Water pools together in oceans, lakes, rivers, and underground, ready to be heated by the sun again.

Precipitation, because tiny drops of liquid are falling from the air onto the table.
Condensation, because invisible water vapor in the warm air cools down and turns into liquid.
